# SYNESIS_E058 — Error

## Description

Value `"value"` in `field_name` has whitespace at the start or end.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The value `"value"` declared in the field 'field_name' has
  whitespace at the start or end. These invisible spaces would
  keep the value from being recognized when used in the annotations.
  Remove the extra spaces around the value in the template declaration.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **ValueWithWhitespace**: `field_name`, `value`
